name: Fatcat_search_scholar
description: Search Internet Archive Scholar's Fatcat release index and retrieve detailed metadata. Results are recoverably paginated: request at most 10 enriched records per call, start with offset=0, and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true. The current Scholar HTML endpoint does not expose an exact total. Each item reports metadata_complete and metadata_error so a failed release-page enrichment is distinguishable from genuinely absent DOI/author/abstract fields.

query.description: Search query for Fatcat releases. Use keywords to search across titles, abstracts, and metadata of research papers.

max_results.description: Number of enriched releases to return per page. Default and maximum are 10; use offset/metadata.next_offset for additional results.

offset.description: Zero-based search-result offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

return_schema.description: List of Fatcat releases matching the search query with detailed metadata

pdf_url.description: URL to PDF version if available

url.description: URL to the paper on scholar.archive.org/fatcat

metadata_complete.description: True when the release detail page was fetched and parsed successfully.

metadata_error.description: Reason detailed metadata could not be fetched, or null on success.
